meta.title: A closed pricing round cannot be rescheduled
gaps: The requested PATCH fields bid_start_time and bid_end_time cannot be expressed; extend_round only changes the round's bid end time.
The expected alternative error codes 4 and 258 cannot be distinguished with the available vocabulary.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with one QA vendor invited, no bids, and its bidding window (with the extra closing time) already over.
steps: The buyer moves the round's bid end time with the increase auction time moved later.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error.
